shell.offline: You are offline. Changes will not be saved until the connection returns.

people.title: People
people.description: Everyone who can sign in. Add a person, give them roles, and revoke access when they leave. A pending person becomes active at their first sign-in.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Directory groups from the identity provider, and local groups you manage here. A role assigned to a group reaches every member.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Named sets of permission keys. A system role is read-only and copyable; a custom role is yours to edit. Who holds a role is decided in Access.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, when, on which record. Events are kept for the tenant's lifetime and never edited.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: The modules this deployment carries. Switch one on or off for everyone, and give it a category. Who can open a module is set in Roles.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Headings that group modules in the navigation.

settings.title: Tenant settings
settings.description: Sign-in, sessions, and the settings each module exposes for this tenant. Branding has its own page.

localAccounts.managed: The tenant realm is brokered only. Ask your Genie operator to add local accounts to the realm.
localAccounts.customer: Local accounts are not available because sign-in uses the company's own realm.

notSaved.signIn: The sign-in settings were not saved.
notSaved.sessions: The idle timeout was not saved.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: How Genie Ops Center looks for the people of this tenant. Changes stay in this browser until you publish.

saveFailure.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
saveFailure.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
saveFailure.refused: You do not have permission to make this change.
saveFailure.conflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload the page to see it.
saveFailure.invalid: Some values are not valid. Fix the marked fields.
saveFailure.retryAfter: Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

noGrants.title: No solutions yet
noGrants.description: Ask your administrator to grant you access to a solution.

access.denied: You may not view this page.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.action: Sign in with your company account

errors.keycloakUnavailable: The identity provider is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.keycloakIssuerMismatch: The identity provider is not the one this deployment was set up with. Contact your administrator.
errors.notRegistered: This account is not registered for this service.
errors.accessDisabled: Access for this account is disabled.
errors.sessionExpired: You were signed out after {minutes} minutes of inactivity. Sign in again.
errors.signedOutClientOnly: You are signed out of {productName}. Your company sign-in stays active.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.description: You have been inactive for a while. For your security, this session ends after {idleMinutes} minutes without activity.
idle.stayFailed: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
